name: add_linear_dimension
author: hprebar
title: Add a linear dimension
description: Adds a dimension between two points given in millimetres, with the dimension line through dimLinePoint: rotated (horizontal by default, or at rotationDeg) or aligned to the two points. Uses the current dimension style unless dimStyle names another. Returns handle and the measured length in mm.

dimLinePoint.description: A point the dimension line passes through, in millimetres

aligned.description: Aligned dimension (parallel to p1–p2) instead of a rotated one

rotationDeg.description: Rotated dimensions only: angle of the dimension line in degrees (0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical)

dimStyle.description: Existing dimension style name; default: the current style

layer.description: Existing layer name; default: the current layer
